channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: Car and Driver Names the Chevrolet Bolt Its EV of the Year
item.dc:creator: Car and Driver
item.description: Twenty five EVs over the same roads, and the award went to the cheapest one: a $29,000 car with a 65 kWh LFP pack, 262 miles of EPA range and real buttons.

item.title: Japan Wants Its Rare Metals Back From Old EV Batteries
item.dc:creator: NHK WORLD-JAPAN
item.description: NHK reports on black mass holding ten times the rare metal of mined ore, and on why roughly 80 percent of Japan's used EVs leave the country anyway.

item.title: Does the Model Y Performance Earn Its Badge on Track?
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Out of Spec finds no track mode, a new Panasonic pack, early thermal limiting, and a launch control that made the car slower than simply flooring it.

item.title: UK EV Sales Ran Nearly Ten to One Against Petrol, Report Says
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric TECH
item.description: SMMT figures cited in the video put new battery EVs at 516,490 against 54,110 new petrol cars in the 12 months to May 2026, with petrol hybrids flat.

item.title: Polestar 4 Discounts Put a Luxury EV at Bolt Money
item.dc:creator: The Electric Viking
item.description: $25,000 off a $56,400 car takes a 544 horsepower crossover to about $31,000, tied to what the video says is Polestar's planned US exit by 2027.

item.title: Three EVs, Three Price Tiers, and What the Extra Money Buys
item.dc:creator: Gjeebs
item.description: Gjeebs lines up the $28,000 Chevy Bolt, the $45,000 Tesla Model Y Premium and a $76,000 Hyundai Ioniq 9 Calligraphy, and the money buys convenience, not capability.

item.title: A Solar Study Says Only Four US Cities Should Cut the Cord
item.dc:creator: Kolob Canyons Ranch
item.description: A 2024 paper modelled off-grid solar against utility rates in 18 US locations. Only four beat the grid, and the deciding number is 25 cents per kilowatt hour.

item.title: Lucid Denies Bankruptcy Talk After Hiring a Restructuring Adviser
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg Television
item.description: Bloomberg reports Lucid engaged AlixPartners. Lucid confirms the hire, says it is about strengthening operations, and says bankruptcy has not been put to the board.

item.title: CATL Built a Grid Battery With No Lithium in It
item.dc:creator: Two Bit da Vinci
item.description: Over 30 MWh per unit, 15,000 cycles, no lithium, no cobalt, no nickel. Two Bit da Vinci on CATL's sodium bet, and the awkward part about the price.

item.title: The Kia EV4 Is a Big, Efficient Sedan Americans Cannot Buy
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec BITS
item.description: Out of Spec BITS drives the 2026 Kia EV4 GT-Line Limited in Canada: 400-volt E-GMP, up to 81.4 kWh, a factory J3400 port, and no US launch on the calendar.

item.title: Porsche's Electric Macan Turbo Costs $150,000 and Has to Prove It
item.dc:creator: Auto Focus
item.description: Auto Focus reviews the 630 hp electric Macan Turbo, a near $150,000 luxury crossover with a stellar cabin, no one-pedal mode, and a CCS port in a NACS world.

item.title: The Ford Mustang Mach-E Rally Is Built for Gravel, With Options That Add Up
item.dc:creator: TFLEV
item.description: TFLEV drives the 480 hp Mach-E Rally, a lifted, snow-tire-equipped EV that is fun to drive but charges extra for the frunk and still runs CCS.

item.title: How China Turned EV Tariffs Into a Global Factory Strategy
item.dc:creator: CNBC
item.description: A CNBC explainer on how tariffs pushed Chinese automakers to build factories worldwide, citing Atlas Public Policy, Rhodium Group, and other analysts.

item.title: The Hyundai Ioniq 9 Bets on Fast Charging and a Six-Seat Cabin
item.dc:creator: Gjeebs
item.description: Gjeebs charge-tests the 800-volt Ioniq 9, a six-seat electric SUV with native NACS clocked from 10 to 80 percent in about 23 minutes.

item.title: Why EV Battery Recycling Does Not Always Pay, and How Colorado Is Responding
item.dc:creator: NPR
item.description: NPR reports that salvage yards get stuck with EV batteries nobody wants, why cheaper LFP chemistry makes it worse, and how a new Colorado law responds.

item.title: Why a Wave of Off-Lease EVs Is About to Reach Used Lots
item.dc:creator: MotorTrend
item.description: MotorTrend's The Inevitable talks to Plug Motors CEO Jimmy Douglas about the roughly 1.1 million EVs coming off lease and why used electric cars are about to get cheaper.

item.title: The Self-Driving Story Nobody Is Telling
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The autonomy debate is all horse race. But for millions of people who cannot drive, a car that drives itself is the keys, handed back. Why Rivian's road to Level 4 matters more than the spec sheet, and the one thing it still has to get right.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
